name: ai.spookylab/mcp
title: Actions by Spooky Lab
description: Expert prompt actions for editing, code review, research, and design, from spookylab.ai.

tools.name: search_actions
tools.description: Matches the words of a query against the names, one-line summaries, For LLM lines, headings, and section text of the prompt actions published on spookylab.ai, and returns the actions that share words with it, highest keyword score first. Each match gives the action's slug, name, section, one-line summary, For LLM line, which is the action's own line on when it applies, and its length in tokens. It compares words, not meaning, and does not read an action's full text, so a request worded differently from an action's own words can return other actions, or none. An action that shares too few words with the query to reach a fixed score is not returned, and a query that matches nothing returns an empty list. It leaves out an action offered only as a prompt.

query.description: Keywords for the topic, such as "database migration" or "APA citations".

limit.description: The most matches to return, from 1 to 10.

tools.name: get_actions
tools.description: Returns the full Markdown text of one to five published actions, named by slug. An action is a prompt its author wrote for a person to apply to their own task, and its steps, such as committing, pushing, and style rules, are the author's defaults for that person. A slug given more than once is returned once. One distinct action is returned exactly as spookylab.ai serves it. Several are returned as one text with each action in an <action name="slug"> tag, in the order given, and a contract the actions share stated once ahead of them. list_actions and search_actions give each action's length in tokens. A call for one action returns that action whole, whatever its length. Several actions whose lengths add up to more than 15,000 tokens are not returned in one result: the call returns an error that gives the total. An action that list_actions shows as available as a prompt returns an error that names the prompt. An unknown slug returns an error that names it and may suggest the closest slugs.

slugs.description: One to five action slugs, as list_actions and search_actions return them.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: Returns the catalog of prompt actions published on spookylab.ai. With no argument it returns every action in one result, in the site's listing order, one line per action: slug, section, one-line summary, and length in tokens. With a section it returns that section's description and its actions, each with its slug, name, one-line summary, and length in tokens. An action shown as available as a prompt is offered as a prompt for a person to pick, and get_actions does not return it.

section.description: A section's label, such as "/proofs", or its folder, such as "academia/proofs". Without it, every action is listed.
